techniques.en: Per-layer attention dispatch for hybrid SWA + GQA
techniques.cn: 混合 SWA + GQA 的逐层 attention 分派
techniques.rocm: `--attention-backend aiter`; full-attention verify goes to FlyDSL, SWA/sink layers and plain decode stay on AITER
techniques.cuda: `--attention-backend fa3` or `flashinfer`; split per layer wherever one kernel does not cover both window types

evidence_note.en: AITER backend on in measured runs; FlyDSL split only in the pinned runtime
evidence_note.cn: 实测时已开 AITER 后端；FlyDSL 分派只在固定 runtime 中

techniques.rocm_cn: `--attention-backend aiter`；全注意力层的 verify 走 FlyDSL，SWA/sink 层和普通 decode 留在 AITER
techniques.cuda_cn: `--attention-backend fa3` 或 `flashinfer`；凡是一个 kernel 覆盖不了两种窗口类型的地方，都按层拆开

precision.en: Different kernels for full and sliding-window layers; each computes exact attention.
precision.cn: 全注意力层和滑动窗口层用不同 kernel，每个都计算精确 attention。

techniques.en: FP8 KV cache in a vectorized 5D page layout
techniques.cn: FP8 KV cache + 向量化 5D 分页布局
techniques.cuda: `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`; FA3/FlashInfer paged layouts already keep a 16-byte inner vector

evidence_note.en: FP8 KV on in measured runs; 5D layout only in the pinned runtime
evidence_note.cn: 实测时已开 FP8 KV；5D 布局只在固定 runtime 中

techniques.cuda_cn: `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`；FA3/FlashInfer 的分页布局本来就保留 16 字节内层向量

precision.en: K and V are stored in FP8 E4M3 (3 mantissa bits) with one scale per tensor, so every cached token loses precision; the 5D layout itself only reorders bytes.
precision.cn: K、V 以 FP8 E4M3（3 位尾数）存储，每个张量一个缩放系数，每个缓存 token 都会损失精度；5D 布局本身只是重排字节。

techniques.en: AITER unified attention for MTP target verify
techniques.cn: MTP target verify 使用 AITER unified attention
techniques.cuda: not needed; CUDA attention backends verify with their own kernels

evidence_note.en: measured A/B, together with the CK GEMM path
evidence_note.cn: 实测 A/B，与 CK GEMM 路径一起打开

techniques.cuda_cn: 不需要；CUDA 的 attention 后端用自己的 kernel 做 verify

precision.en: Selects which attention kernel verifies draft tokens; same exact attention.
precision.cn: 只决定用哪个 attention kernel 校验草稿 token，计算的仍是精确 attention。

techniques.en: Multi-layer EAGLE MTP speculative decoding and verifier fixes
techniques.cn: 多层 EAGLE MTP 投机解码及校验修复

evidence_note.en: on in measured runs with fixed acceptance; f26ae30 and 878fff1 only in the pinned runtime
evidence_note.cn: 实测时以固定接受长度打开；f26ae30、878fff1 只在固定 runtime 中

precision.en: Speculative decoding keeps the target model's output distribution only if verification is right. On HIP, sampled verification silently fell back to greedy until 878fff1, so temperature had no effect.
precision.cn: 投机解码只有在校验正确时才保持目标模型的输出分布。在 HIP 上，878fff1 之前采样校验会悄悄退回贪心，temperature 实际不起作用。

techniques.en: Chunked prefill, page size and SWA pool sizing
techniques.cn: Chunked prefill、page size 与 SWA 池容量
techniques.cuda: same flags; re-derive the values from HBM size and kernel page support

evidence_note.en: measured runs used chunk 32768 and page 32

techniques.cuda_cn: 同一组开关；具体数值按 HBM 容量和 kernel 支持的 page size 重新推算

precision.en: Chunk and page sizes change how work is split, not what is computed; the SWA ratio only sizes the pool.
precision.cn: chunk 和 page 大小改变的是切分方式，不是计算内容；SWA 比例只决定池子大小。

techniques.rocm: on by default on the decode server: do not pass `--disable-cuda-graph` there (the prefill server keeps it)
techniques.cuda: same default with CUDA graphs; `--cuda-graph-max-bs` bounds the captured batch sizes

evidence_note.en: measured A/B on the baseline stack (Triton attention, no MTP)
evidence_note.cn: 在基线栈上实测 A/B（Triton attention，无 MTP）

techniques.rocm_cn: decode 服务上默认打开：不要给 decode 服务传 `--disable-cuda-graph`（prefill 服务保留该参数）
techniques.cuda_cn: 默认行为相同，使用 CUDA graph；`--cuda-graph-max-bs` 限定捕获的 batch 上限

precision.en: The captured graph replays the same kernels; it removes launch overhead, not arithmetic.
precision.cn: 捕获的图重放的是同一批 kernel；省掉的是 launch 开销，算术不变。

techniques.cuda: CuTe DSL or FlashInfer decode; partitions correspond to split-KV
techniques.cuda_cn: CuTe DSL 或 FlashInfer 的 decode kernel；partition 数对应 split-KV

precision.en: Exact paged attention. The two fixed defects (unstaged query elements, 32-bit offset overflow) produced wrong output, not small drift, which is why the kernel refuses untested shapes.
precision.cn: 精确 paged attention。已修复的两个缺陷（query 元素未搬入、32 位偏移溢出）产生的是错误输出，而不是小幅漂移，所以这个 kernel 会拒绝没测过的 shape。

techniques.en: Block-scale FP8 GEMM with pre-shuffled weights
techniques.cn: 权重预重排的 block-scale FP8 GEMM

evidence_note.en: measured A/B, together with unified verify
evidence_note.cn: 实测 A/B，与 unified verify 一起打开

techniques.cuda_cn: DeepGEMM（`SGLANG_ENABLE_JIT_DEEPGEMM=1`）或 CUTLASS 的 block-scale GEMM

precision.en: Both the Triton path and the CK path quantize activations to FP8 per 1x128 block against the same FP8 block-scale checkpoint; the switch changes the kernel, not the precision.
precision.cn: Triton 路径和 CK 路径都按 1x128 块把激活量化成 FP8，权重都是同一份 FP8 block-scale checkpoint；这个开关换的是 kernel，不是精度。

techniques.en: INT8 Quick Reduce for tensor-parallel all-reduce
techniques.cn: 张量并行 all-reduce 使用 INT8 Quick Reduce
techniques.rocm: `ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT8` (set by the base image; `NONE` turns it off)
techniques.cuda: no default equivalent; NCCL and the SGLang custom all-reduce sum in full precision
techniques.rocm_cn: `ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT8`（基础镜像默认设置；设为 `NONE` 即关闭）
techniques.cuda_cn: 默认没有对应功能；NCCL 和 SGLang 自定义 all-reduce 都按全精度求和

evidence_note.en: on in the measured throughput runs, inherited from the base image; not isolated
evidence_note.cn: 实测吞吐时已打开，继承自基础镜像；未单独拆分

precision.en: Tensor-parallel all-reduces that go through Quick Reduce are quantized to INT8 before the partial sums from the 8 GPUs are added.
precision.cn: 走 Quick Reduce 的张量并行 all-reduce，会先把各卡的部分和量化成 INT8，再在 8 张卡之间相加。

techniques.cn: 按 shape 调优的 fused-MoE kernel 表
techniques.cuda_cn: 用 `tuning_fused_moe_triton.py` 生成的 Triton fused-MoE JSON

precision.en: Chooses among existing fused-MoE kernels per token count; the model math is unchanged.
precision.cn: 按 token 数在已有 fused-MoE kernel 中选择，模型计算不变。

techniques.rocm: CK patch shipped in AITER `3f4ab48`, dispatched only for the exact shape
techniques.cuda: check that the paged prefill path does not fall back to gather-then-dense
techniques.rocm_cn: AITER `3f4ab48` 自带的 CK patch，只对这个精确 shape 分派
techniques.cuda_cn: 确认分页 prefill 路径没有退回到「先 gather 再算稠密 attention」

precision.en: Replaces the padded head-256 path with an exact head-192 tile.
precision.cn: 去掉补齐到 head 256 的路径，改用精确的 head-192 tile。

techniques.cn: 混合精度 Triton router（MoE gate）GEMM
techniques.rocm: `SGLANG_MIMO_MIXED_ROUTER=1` for router batches of at least 2,048 tokens
techniques.cuda: the same Triton kernel compiles for CUDA; re-tune block sizes
techniques.rocm_cn: `SGLANG_MIMO_MIXED_ROUTER=1`，用于 token 数不少于 2,048 的 router batch
techniques.cuda_cn: 同一个 Triton kernel 在 CUDA 上也能编译；重新调 block 大小即可

precision.en: Router weights drop from FP32 to FP16 and activations from BF16 to FP16 before accumulation. Router logits pick the top-8 experts, so a small change can flip which experts a token uses.
precision.cn: router 权重从 FP32 降到 FP16，激活从 BF16 转成 FP16 后再累加。router logits 决定选哪 8 个专家，微小变化就可能换掉 token 用的专家。

techniques.cuda: same flags; mooncake or nixl over GPUDirect RDMA
techniques.cuda_cn: 同一组开关；通过 GPUDirect RDMA 使用 mooncake 或 nixl

precision.en: The KV cache is copied between servers byte for byte.
precision.cn: KV cache 在两个服务之间逐字节拷贝。

techniques.cn: 一个路由后挂多个 prefill 副本（DP=2）
techniques.rocm: one complete TP8 server per VM, both registered with one `sglang_router`
techniques.cuda: same router and flags; each replica needs its own full model copy

evidence_note.en: measured: 1 against 2 requests in flight on two replicas
evidence_note.cn: 实测：两个副本上 1 个与 2 个请求同时在跑的对比

techniques.rocm_cn: 每台 VM 一个完整的 TP8 服务，两个服务注册到同一个 `sglang_router`
techniques.cuda_cn: 路由和参数相同；每个副本都要一份完整模型

precision.en: Each request runs entirely on one replica; nothing is split or approximated.
precision.cn: 每个请求完整地跑在一个副本上，没有任何切分或近似。

evidence_note.en: in the pinned runtime's scripts; not used in the published runs
evidence_note.cn: 在固定 runtime 的脚本里；已发布的测试没有用到

techniques.cuda_cn: 上游 SGLang 的同一功能

precision.en: The decode server starts from a KV cache that was never computed from the prompt.
precision.cn: decode 服务从一份并非由 prompt 算出来的 KV cache 开始。

techniques.en: Fixed MTP acceptance for performance runs
techniques.cn: 性能测试固定 MTP 接受长度
techniques.cuda_cn: 上游 SGLang 的同一组变量

precision.en: Draft tokens are accepted by rule, not by the model, so the generated text is not the model's output.
precision.cn: 草稿 token 按规则被接受，而不是由模型决定，生成的文本不是模型的输出。

techniques.en: Concurrency ladder against the saturation point
techniques.cn: 按饱和点设计并发阶梯
techniques.rocm: `bench_serving --max-concurrency 16 ... 256` with fixed prompts, warmup and seed

precision.en: Changes the number of in-flight requests, not the model or its answers. Scoring eligibility depends on the dataset and whether a synthetic measurement mode is enabled.
precision.cn: 只改变同时在途的请求数，不改变模型或人为替换回答。能否评分取决于数据集，以及是否开启了模拟测量模式。

stack_values.measured-run: switched on in the published Microsoft runs
stack_values.pinned-runtime: present in the final pinned runtime, not throughput-tested here
stack_values.later: on a later branch, in no runtime described here

same-math.en: Same arithmetic contract; only kernel, layout or schedule changes. Results can differ in the last bits because the summation order changes, not systematically.
same-math.cn: 算术约定不变，只换 kernel、布局或调度。求和顺序变了，结果可能在最后几位有差异，但不是系统性偏差。

lossy.en: Fewer bits somewhere on the data path. Can shift outputs systematically and must be checked with an accuracy benchmark before production.
lossy.cn: 数据通路上某处用了更少的比特，可能让输出产生系统性偏移，上线前必须用准确率基准核对。

output-contract.en: Designed to leave the output distribution unchanged, but only if the implementation is correct; a bug changes outputs without any error message.
output-contract.cn: 设计上不改变输出分布，但前提是实现正确；一旦有 bug，输出会变而且不报错。

measurement-only.en: Outputs produced in this mode are not model answers and must never be scored for accuracy.
measurement-only.cn: 这种模式下生成的内容不是模型的回答，绝不能拿来算准确率。
